notes.title: [NEWS] Closed Alpha Testing — Join Our Discord!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

It’s been quite a journey for me, and the progress on [b]Mannequin Syndrome[/b] is ongoing! The game is still in development, with a lot happening behind the scenes. Many updates might not be visible here because I focus more on sharing news, work-in-progress screenshots, and even closed testing opportunities in my [b]Discord[/b] community!

[b]Yes, you read that right:[/b] it’s possible to playtest the game! For now, playtesting is handled through Discord (with the playtest itself on Steam). Reports and feedback are always appreciated to help improve the game!

If you’re interested in following the progress, want to see how your ideas could be implemented, or just want to chat with me (the dev), the Discord community is the place to be!

---

[h3]My goal is to make the game scary and fun for everyone—face the horrors alone for a real challenge, or join friends and see if teamwork helps you survive![/h3]

---

[h2]Here are some Work In Progress features:[/h2]

- [b]A walkable main menu![/b]
  More features and content are planned for future updates!  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611655/37cc11d26ae7c6ea87d1625fccafe013cab30eaa.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611655/62ca5356dc080cb77d36522d6a39e657dd67c392.jpg[/img]

- [b]Lobby system up to 4 players![/b]
  Still a work in progress—improvements and tweaks coming soon!  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611655/10a26866dc41e3b2911ec02e7c0385befe8ce2ed.jpg[/img]

- [b](WIP) Selectable characters! For only one is available, rest are in progress![/b]
  One is fully playable now, and more will be added soon :)  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611655/06f6671bd499dee4df69aa7e229070edff93916b.gif[/img]

- [b]Full first playable map with objectives![/b]
  Still tweaking things, but you can already try to complete the level!  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611655/282a943b3e650d5fec6892c01dd1b3b5c236bb1d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611655/111d74ec894ac1507a0c7350db3d3d7e64b676d7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611655/c847ef3e360ad1e024a068704752261125de3b16.png[/img]

-[b] “Friends” who want to get rid of you[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611655/66c1676ef5839dc01d528dda014d64d79f54a42f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611655/e0a114038da87ef754d9d0f0f9790101896b20a1.jpg[/img]

[i]And much more is in progress![/i]

---

[b]Discord:[/b]
https://discord.gg/TkajhAtwhT  
[i]Heads up: don’t forget to verify when you join, or you won’t see the channels![/i]

---
[h2]What to expect in Discord:[/h2]

- Frequent updates as I work on new features, fix bugs, and improve the game
- Honest progress—no polished marketing talk
- Support straight from me: if you have any issues, questions, or feedback, I’m always here (most of the time)!
- A chance to help shape the game and even appear in the Credits later!

---

[b]Mannequin Syndrome is still a work in progress, and the community is a big part of where the game will go next.[/b]

[i]Join the Discord to follow the progress and chat with me![/i]

---

Thanks to everyone who is already helping me make Mannequin Syndrome better!

[b]Remember one thing — They never meant to move![/b]
